services.name: Miami River Cruise | 1:30 Hours
services.desc: Why go bar hopping… when you can hop on the bar! Cruise the popular Miami River. Pick up a couple of your favorite beverages and relax... but be prepared to have your picture taken because you're aboard the most photographed boat on the water! - Enjoy!

includes: Bluetooth radio with 6 speakers and sub-woofer
USCG-approved life jackets for every passenger
First aid kit and all Coast Guard required safety equipment
blurb: Guests bring their own beverages and cruise on a floating tiki bar boat seating 6 passengers plus crew. The boat includes a cooler with ice, Bluetooth radio, and USCG safety equipment. Private charters are available for parties and special events.
